name: Snowflake
verdict: No Snowflake review, but each customer's admin must run CREATE SECURITY INTEGRATION in their own account and send you the client ID, secret and account URL. You ship in 1-3 days; onboarding is likely 15-60 minutes each.
needGuide: Yes — give customers a copy-paste SQL template for the security integration.

auth.detail: No central developer registration: each customer account admin creates a custom OAuth client with CREATE SECURITY INTEGRATION (TYPE=OAUTH, OAUTH_CLIENT=CUSTOM) and hands you a client ID/secret and their account URL. Authorization code grant at <account_url>/oauth/authorize and /oauth/token-request; PKCE S256 optional but recommended (can be required). Access token 600 s default (60-3600 s); refresh tokens only if OAUTH_ISSUE_REFRESH_TOKENS is on, with the refresh-token scope, validity set per integration. Alternatives: PATs (15-day default, 365-day max, network policy needed) and key-pair auth (not re-verified).

effort.timeToFirstTest: 1-2 hours (needs a Snowflake account where you hold admin rights)
effort.timeToProduction: 1-3 days to ship; each customer onboarding takes their admin about 15-60 min plus change approval (likely)

approval.gate: None from Snowflake for custom clients: no review or partner agreement. The gate is per customer: their admin must create the security integration in their account. Partner OAuth (Tableau, Looker, Alation, ThoughtSpot, Collibra) uses predefined OAUTH_CLIENT values; no route for arbitrary developers is described.

scopes.why: Tokens are pinned to a role (session:role:<name>); admin roles are blocked unless Snowflake Support changes it.
scopes.summary: session:role:<role_name> pins the token to one case-sensitive role; session:role-any allows USE ROLE only if OAUTH_ANY_ROLE_MODE is enabled; refresh_token requests offline access. Pin to a read-only role for agent use. Blocked admin roles need a Snowflake Support request.

cost: Free to implement; needs a Snowflake account (trial likely sufficient) for testing.
prerequisites: Account and owner: Developer team needs a test Snowflake account where one member is ACCOUNTADMIN (or has CREATE INTEGRATION) to run the SQL.

Where you register: In the customer's account, as ACCOUNTADMIN or a role with global CREATE INTEGRATION: CREATE SECURITY INTEGRATION ... TYPE=OAUTH OAUTH_CLIENT=CUSTOM OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI='<your callback>' (plus token-validity and refresh-token options); then retrieve the generated client ID and secrets
Cost: Free to implement; needs a Snowflake account (trial likely sufficient) for testing.

registerAt.path: In the customer's account, as ACCOUNTADMIN or a role with global CREATE INTEGRATION: CREATE SECURITY INTEGRATION ... TYPE=OAUTH OAUTH_CLIENT=CUSTOM OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI='<your callback>' (plus token-validity and refresh-token options); then retrieve the generated client ID and secrets

steps.do: Give customers a copy-paste SQL template for CREATE SECURITY INTEGRATION (OAUTH_CLIENT=CUSTOM, your redirect URI, OAUTH_ISSUE_REFRESH_TOKENS=TRUE, PKCE required)
Customer ACCOUNTADMIN runs the SQL and sends client ID, client secret and account URL
Store per-customer client credentials and account URL encrypted
Redirect to <account_url>/oauth/authorize with session:role:<ROLE>, refresh_token scope, state and S256 PKCE; exchange at /oauth/token-request
Refresh before the 10-minute access token expires; handle refresh-token expiry by re-prompting the user
Verify with a non-ACCOUNTADMIN role and a network policy in place

roles.team: Developer team needs a test Snowflake account where one member is ACCOUNTADMIN (or has CREATE INTEGRATION) to run the SQL.
roles.console: none documented (no developer console; configuration is SQL per account)
roles.customer: Customer ACCOUNTADMIN or a role with global CREATE INTEGRATION creates the integration. Admin controls: BLOCKED_ROLES_LIST, ALLOWED_ROLES_LIST, token validity, refresh-token toggle, network policies. ACCOUNTADMIN, SECURITYADMIN, GLOBALORGADMIN and ORGADMIN roles can never be consented to by default.

testing: Create the integration in your own trial/dev account and run the full authorize, token and refresh cycle in a browser (the authorize URL cannot be curled).
Test per-account URL handling with two accounts if possible.

blockers.problem: Each customer must create their own integration
blockers.fix: Ship a clear SQL template and runbook.

blockers.problem: Admin roles are blocked from OAuth consent
Redirect URI must match exactly and use TLS unless OAUTH_ALLOW_NON_TLS_REDIRECT_URI is set

automation.agentCan: Draft and parameterize the SQL template, write the OAuth/PKCE client and token refresh, generate the customer runbook, and run test queries.
automation.humanMust: A customer ACCOUNTADMIN must run the SQL, share secrets securely and approve network policies; your team must log in to a test account.

uncertain: Default refresh-token validity, key-pair auth details and current partner-program rules were not confirmed (fetch limit reached).
Custom-client OAuth for multi-tenant SaaS pitfalls from community sources were not consulted.
